facts.quote: 금발의 외국인, 스켈레톤 킹이 득의양양한 목소리로 대답했다.

facts.fact: Has a strikingly handsome face, designed by Magic Johnson to suit particular tastes
Appears as a young human with a familiar face
Wears a golden crown that radiates brilliant light
facts.quote: 그의 황금빛 왕관이 토해 내는 광휘가 비치고 있었다

facts.fact: Considered ugly-faced (self-described as handsome in a past form, but currently has an ugly face)
facts.quote: 가뜩이나 못생긴 얼굴로 인상 쓰지 말고.

facts.fact: Skull with blue ghost-fire flickering in place of eyes
facts.quote: 눈동자 대신 시퍼런 귀화(鬼火)가 일렁이고 있는 해골을

ranges.description: Skeleton King is a young-looking human man with blond hair and golden eyes. He has a strikingly handsome face, and his hands look almost human. He wears a golden crown that radiates brilliant light. Tags: male, young, blond hair, golden eyes, handsome face, human hands, golden crown, radiant light, gold motif

Skeleton King is a skull-faced man with an ugly, scowling face. Blue ghost-fire flickers in the eye sockets in place of eyes. He wears a golden crown that radiates brilliant light. Tags: male, skull, ugly face, blue ghost-fire eyes, golden crown, radiant light, gold and blue motif
